acceptanceCriteria: A supported in-place upgrade is specified: stop dispatcher, swap binary, restart, adopt live workers; live attempts keep heartbeating, renewing and releasing under the new binary.
A compatibility check between adjacent builds covers store and lease formats and refuses with a named code when they are not compatible.
A maintained test exercises an attempt claimed under build N continuing (heartbeat, renew, release) under build N+1, and the incompatible case refusing.
The spec amendment is recorded as proposed until the owner accepts.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

GitHub beamfall/corvint#644: every build switch on 2026-10-06 required draining the queue to zero live attempts (one drain took about 1h50m; a 45-minute window expired). dispatch already adopts live workers on restart.

completion.reason: Delivered in PR beamfall/corvint#648 (rc3 batch 4), merged to main 2026-10-07T12:32:21Z as 8c02f2552421b718b9d9b94d75f6d0afc1a11984 (head 580fcde4, base 0c27e35f48581601fbfaf9613d0216b5f8ca3a46). Evidence (each digest is that file's sha256 at the merge commit): sealed CEM .corvint/changes/4497acbdc2443a7558337ed650bcea433fc9ae64.cem.json; docs/decisions/0439-rc3-batch-4-requirements-accepted-2026-10-07.md (owner acceptance of the batch 4 requirements); docs/build-log/2026-10-06-v1-0889-live-upgrade.md. Manual route because native completion is refused for a reason unrelated to evidence: on V1-0904, claim, submit (tree 6b9f2b71) and gate run focused-docs in a clean worktree at the merge commit all succeeded, but complete --commit 8c02f255 refused STALE_TREE with warning 'commit 8c02f2552421b718b9d9b94d75f6d0afc1a11984 is not reachable from main'. Local main in the primary checkout is cd70ba0a and holds 2,651 uncommitted paths that may not be touched, so it cannot be fast-forwarded; that attempt was released with reason STALE_TREE. NOT_RUN: make gate, -race, live fleet qualification where the spec says so; macOS CPU ticks not delivered (decision 0439 limits).

title: corvint-tasks: upgrade the binary with live attempts (dispatcher adopt plus compatibility) instead of draining (GitHub #644)
